description: Source code for AWS Secrets Manager integration, including async and sync secret read/write/delete operations, environment validation, and request signing using boto3. Defines the AWSSecretsManagerV2 class with methods for secret management.

classes.name: AWSSecretsManagerV2
classes.description: Class for managing AWS Secrets Manager secrets asynchronously and synchronously, with environment validation and request signing.

methods.name: validate_environment
methods.description: Checks for AWS region environment variables and logs a warning if none are set.

methods.name: load_aws_secret_manager
methods.description: Initializes the secret manager client with settings from key_management_settings if use_aws_secret_manager is True.

methods.name: async_read_secret
methods.description: Asynchronously reads a secret value from AWS Secrets Manager, with support for primary secret fallback.

methods.name: sync_read_secret
methods.description: Synchronously reads a secret value, with fallback to environment variables and primary secret.

methods.name: _parse_primary_secret
methods.description: Parses a JSON string of primary secret key-value pairs into a dictionary.

methods.name: sync_read_secret_from_primary_secret
methods.description: Retrieves a secret value from a primary secret JSON.

methods.name: async_read_secret_from_primary_secret
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a secret value from a primary secret JSON.

methods.name: async_write_secret
methods.description: Asynchronously writes a secret to AWS Secrets Manager, with optional description, tags, and parameters.

methods.name: async_delete_secret
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a secret from AWS Secrets Manager with recovery window.

methods.name: _prepare_request
methods.description: Prepares and signs an AWS Secrets Manager request using SigV4.
